sources.content: The ruvelle-scheduler image runs the Ruvelle workflow scheduler. It is built on python:3.12-slim and runs as user ruvelle with user ID 5000. The web interface listens on port 8800. Workflow definitions are loaded from /opt/ruvelle/flows, which you mount from the host. The entrypoint is /opt/ruvelle/bin/ruvelle and the default command is scheduler, so pass webserver to start the web interface in a second container instead. The image is published for amd64 and arm64.

Configuration. RUVELLE_DB_URL sets the Postgres connection string; without it the scheduler uses a SQLite file at /opt/ruvelle/data/ruvelle.db, which is meant only for testing. RUVELLE_PARALLELISM limits running tasks and defaults to 16. RUVELLE_SCAN_SECONDS sets how often the flows folder is rescanned and defaults to 60. The image ships with a health check that calls the scheduler's heartbeat command every 30 seconds. RUVELLE_LOG_LEVEL defaults to info. Task logs are written to /opt/ruvelle/logs, one folder per workflow run.
